title: Alder Bay parcel lockers

sentences.text: Alder Bay is testing parcel lockers at its public library.

The report says 25 percent of residents used https://alder.example.test/lockers during the trial, and this move brings a major change to the town while officials prepare detailed weekly notices for every resident and explain the next steps at several public meetings.
This move brings a significant benefit to every family in the area.
